attchmntText: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited issued a clarification regarding the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company stated that the name of the Statutory Auditors was incorrectly mentioned in the covering letter submitted on November 12, 2026. The correct name is M/s Raju & Prasad, not M/s K. Raju & Prasad. The company confirmed there is no change in the Financial Results or the Limited Review Report. The error was due to an inadvertent typographical mistake. The Executive Director, J. B. Sharma, requested the stock exchanges to take this clarification on record.

attchmntText: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has published newspaper advertisements regarding its audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in the Financial Express, Loksatta, and Navbharat. This intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III Part A Para A of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company is listed on the BSE with script code 524230 and on the NSE with script code RCF EQ. The ISINs are INE027A07012, INE027A080101, and INE027A08028. The notice was signed by J. B. Sharma, Executive Director, on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms Nazhat J Shaikh as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. December 01, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has appointed Ms. Nazhat J. Shaikh, DIN 07348075, as Director Finance and Chief Financial Officer effective December 1, 2026, until March 31, 2027. The Board approved this reappointment on November 12, 2026, following an order from the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers dated October 23, 2026. The company also appointed M/s. J.Singh & Associates as Chartered Accountants and M/s. Bandyopadhyaya Bhaumik & Co. as Cost Accountants as internal auditors. This appointment is for a period of three years, covering financial years 2026-27 to 2028-29. The Board meeting commenced at 12.00 noon and concluded at 3.00 on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited Board approved Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone profit after tax was 131.45 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 105.69 crore in the same period last year. Half-year profit after tax stood at 205.74 crore. Basic earnings per share were 2.38 for the quarter and 3.73 for the half year. The company noted a disputed amount of 123.57 crore regarding gas pooling for FY 2022-23, with total exposure of 203.41 crore. A revision in energy norms for the Thal Unit decreased subsidy income by 132.52 crore for FY 2025-26. An amount of 217.50 crore remains pending for settlement by the Department of Fertilizers regarding price adversity on P&K fertilizers.
